note: Proposed demonstration dataset. Not approved production requirements. Add stories here without changing the agent architecture.

stories.title: Import and Analyze User Stories
stories.description: As a Requirements Analyst, I want to import a user story from a local demonstration source or Jira so that I can analyze its requirements and prepare it for the SDLC pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Retrieve a story by its unique ID.
Extract title, description, acceptance criteria, and metadata.
Return a meaningful Not Found result for invalid IDs.
Support local demo stories without Jira credentials.
Record the source of the story.

stories.title: Generate Structured Requirements
stories.description: As a Requirements Analyst, I want to transform an imported user story into structured functional and non-functional requirements so that development can proceed using an approved specification.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify non-functional requirements when supported by the source.
Do not silently invent missing information.

stories.title: Analyze Documentation Changes
stories.description: As a developer, I want to identify documentation files affected by an approved requirement or implementation change so that only relevant documentation is updated.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the relationship between requirements and documentation.
Explain why each file was selected.
Allow review of proposed changes before application.

stories.title: Synchronize Documentation
stories.description: As a developer, I want to synchronize approved documentation changes with the project source so that documentation reflects the current approved implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Handle missing files and empty documentation.
Trace changes to their originating requirements or stories.

stories.title: Review and Audit Documentation Changes
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to review documentation synchronization results and their supporting evidence so that I can verify correctness before changes are merged.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace changes to the originating story and requirements.
Allow the reviewer to approve or reject proposed changes.
Never merge changes without explicit human approval.
